title: CSV parser mis-splits multiline quoted rows
control: parseCsvLine handles commas/quotes but parseCsvText splits raw lines first

evidence:
node repro with input `sku,name
A1,"hello
world"
B2,bye` produced three rows instead of two; downstream master-inventory parsing treated the injected newline as a row boundary and emitted errors for the wrong records

sink: row-object construction and later SKU/stock matching
impact: malformed imports can land updates on the wrong SKU or corrupt inventory/catalog data
